nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Top-level project readme for SousVide (Scene Understanding via Synthesized Visual Inertial Data from Experts), covering installation steps (submodules, ACADOS build, conda environment, GSplat download) and pointing users to the notebooks/ folder for FiGS and SousVide usage examples.

nodes.name: environment_x86.yml
nodes.summary: Conda environment specification (env name 'kitchen') pinning Python 3.10, PyTorch 2.1.2 with CUDA 11.8, and pip-installed research dependencies including nerfstudio, tiny-cuda-nn, and editable installs of the local FiGS and sousvide packages.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses conda's mixed conda/pip dependency blocks plus git and local editable (`-e`) pip installs for submodule packages (FiGS, acados_template, Hierarchical-Localization).

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Python packaging configuration (setuptools build-backend) defining the 'sousvide' package, version 0.1.0, requiring Python >=3.10 with core scientific/ML dependencies (numpy, scipy, qpsolvers, albumentations, torch, torchvision, nerfstudio), and locating packages under src/.
